zh-CN.title: 城市气泡本体重塑
items: 四座城市拥有各自独立的气泡材质与轮廓
冰箱贴缩小并移至边缘，不再遮挡短消息
连续消息圆角和各类媒体卡片同步适配

en.title: City bubble surfaces rebuilt
items: Each city now has a distinct surface and silhouette
Magnets are smaller and moved to the edge to keep text clear
Grouped messages and media cards follow the new treatment
